pass_rule.text: Every condition of a criterion (including sub-category conditions, where present) has the same weight. Each unmet condition deducts its share of the criterion's points. The criterion passes when at least 80% of its conditions are met (4 of 5, 5 of 6, 8 of 10) and fails below 80% (3 of 4, 4 of 6, 5 of 7); a failed criterion keeps its partial points. Only the pass conditions are graded: criteria have no fail list.

scoring.formula:
Skill Standard = Average of all skills for one competency
AI Application/QA Output Quality
Competency Score = Skill Standard*0.2 + AI Application * 0.5 + QA Output Quality * 0.3
Proposed Passing Rules: No Competency Score <3 and AI Safety & Responsible Use is Pass
scoring.group_score_text: A group's score is the mean of its criteria scores; criteria in a group have equal weight.
scoring.competency_score: A*0.2 + B*0.5 + C*0.3, using each group's weight

per_competency.text: Every group is scored separately for each competency the profile covers: B and C from the work done for that competency, A from the skills that belong to it.

skill_to_competency.text: The judge (AI agent) decides which competency each submitted skill belongs to, with a reason; the final report lists the mapping, and the trainer reviews it.

scoring.criterion_score: A group is worth 5 points, shared equally by its criteria (5 / n each). A criterion earns its share x (conditions met / conditions total), so each unmet condition deducts an equal slice; a failed criterion keeps the partial points.
scoring.pass_threshold_text: Competency Score (0-5) = A*0.2 + B*0.5 + C*0.3 with A, B, C in points out of 5; pass when it is >= 3 (the old 'no competency score < 3'), for every competency, and the safety gate passes.
